description:
Because:
- MetricsFactory lived in fxa-shared/nestjs, apart from the other StatsD providers.
- The statsd library is the place for all StatsD providers.

This commit:
- Adds LegacyMetricsProvider (token 'METRICS') to @fxa/shared/metrics/statsd.
- Uses it in 4 admin-server modules and 3 event-broker modules.
- Adds the statsd path to fxa-event-broker tsconfig.build.json.
- Updates the fxa-shared nestjs README example.
- Deletes fxa-shared/nestjs/metrics.service.ts.

Closes FXA-14694
